newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil may announce first B Band winners next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil may announce first B Band winners next week.

text.p: Brazil's Communications Ministry may announce next week the winners of the first two B Band concession areas, including Sao Paulo state and Brasilia, a ministry spokesman said.

Francisco Mendonca said the five consortia that failed to qualify for the bidding have five working days to appeal the ministry's decision, after which the winners of areas one and seven would be announced.
"If no appeals are filed, theoretically the winners could be announced for those areas," Mendonca said.
But representatives of consortia interested in operating cellular services on Brazil's B Band frequency expect tough legal battles in the privatization.

Area seven is comprised of central-western Brazil, including Brasilia, Goias state and the Amazonian states of Acre, Rondonia and Tocantins. Only the Americel consortium has qualified to bid in this area.
Area one includes the city of Sao Paulo and is viewed as one of the choicest concession areas because of its huge pent-up demand and large population.
